title: Concerning adultery and divorce
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.label: A
nodes.title: The teaching about the sin of adultery

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
Parables about parts of one's body.
The outside correspondence is about adultery. The inner correspondence recommends to avoid Gehenna by discarding even body parts. This structure is severe warning against adultery.
In 5:21-47, five pericopes starts with same phrase "you have heard" and citation of Old Testament. 5:31 includes citation of Old Testament but doesn't include "you have heard". Therefore, the editor of Matthew might have editted 5:31 to integrate original two pericopes (5:27-30 and 5:31-32). 5:27 includes citation of Exodus 20:14 and Deuteronomy 5:18. 5:31 includes Deuteronomy 24:1
